nom: IT Cosmetics Bye Bye Breakout Salicylic Acid Acne Serum

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin report the serum keeps oil in check later in the day and helps minimize breakouts, with one describing it as controlling both oil and acne frequency.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers, including one with rosacea, generally report the serum works without irritation, redness, or excess dryness, though one very sensitive user still had ongoing breakouts despite tolerating the product.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers, some also describing flaking or sensitivity, report it does not dry out their skin and helps control breakouts.
segments.mature: Older reviewers (50s-60s) report continued use for adult/hormonal acne and rosacea-related breakouts with positive results and no added dryness.

concerns.spots: Most reviewers report individual pimples or zits shrinking or disappearing within 1-4 days when used as a spot treatment; a few (e.g. reviews 3, 6, 18) saw no change in new or existing spots.
concerns.blemishes: Many reviewers describe fewer and smaller breakouts over weeks of regular use, including teens and adults with hormonal or occasional blemishes; some report no improvement at all and one describes the product triggering more surrounding pimples than before (purging that did not resolve).
concerns.aging: A few reviewers in their 30s-60s use it for adult-onset or persistent hormonal acne alongside anti-aging routines, reporting clearer skin without mention of independent anti-aging effects.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers note reduced redness around blemishes and calmer-looking skin after use; no dissent reported on this specific point.
concerns.barrier: A minority of reviewers with sensitive or reactive skin report only light, expected dryness and no barrier disruption, while one reviewer with sensitive skin says most acne products dry or irritate her skin generally (though this product did not, in her case).
concerns.oiliness: Oily-skin reviewers report the serum keeps skin drier later in the day and slightly reduces oil production; no negative reports on oiliness were found.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers explicitly note the serum does not dry out skin despite containing salicylic acid; one reviewer found it too sticky rather than drying, and no reviewer reported worsened dehydration.

aspects.libelle: Long-lasting, a little goes a long way

extraits.texte: I understand the purging process but this stuff REALLY makes me purge . when I already have pimples it brings them to a whitehead(good) but the surrounding area results in more and more pimples popping up indefinitely. Like if my skin thought about a breakout, this stuff brings so so many more pimples to the surface for weeks!! When I stop this serum, my face clears up beautifully in days. ive tried this a few separate occasions and this always happens. Do not recommend.

I am 52 and have had acne breakouts and rosacea for the past 2 yrs. after a lifetime of clear skin. Nothing worked as my skin is sensitive. This serum works!! It has cured my rosacea and my acne is almost completely gone. I use at night followed by Cerave night moisturizer and then in the morning a light coat followed by cerave say spf moisturizer. Loving my skin again!! Thank you It Cosmetics!!

I have been using this product for a little over 2 weeks now. I do not seem to be having the opposite effect of causing more acne! Most products for acne make my skin extremely dry and sensitive or break me out even further. I am still having breakouts even though i am using this serum as much as my face can tolerate. Again, i have very sensitive skin and it does not usually react well to most products and makeup. I will keep using it until it is gone. I have noticed that when breakouts happen, within a few days they are reduced or gone, which is a bit quicker than letting them naturally fade away on their own over time.

I dont ususally leave reviews for products but my god this one changes eberything! I have oily to dry acne prone skin and have been struggling with these red acne scars and clogged poors a lot recently. Well when i saw this product was half on, i figured id try it! Oh my gosh they are not lying when they say you see results after the first few days! After day two i already noticed significant decrease in my acne scars! Its been 1 week and im loving the results! I will update if anything changes but i say give this a try if you havent.

extraits.titre: I will absolutely purchase again when I run out!
extraits.texte: I'm in my 30's and have been suffering hormonal acne for some years now, the awful cystic kind around the jawline. While makeup could only cover so much, I was frustrated to tears! I've been using this consistently for about a month now, it is slowly fading old spots, and I'm happy to say this is my first cycle without an active breakout! A little goes a long way and I'm excited to see what my skin will look like in the next couple of months. I've got severely sensitive skin and haven't experienced anything other than light dryness which is expected.

extraits.titre: My Acne Skin Care HOLY GRAIL
extraits.texte: This is the best acne treatment that I've ever found. For reference, I have combination skin that is prone to flaking and is sensitive. I have used prescription products to help my acne, but this has made SIGNIFICANT improvement to my skin. When I have acne flare ups, I turn this this serum and in a WEEK, my acne is nearly GONE.

This is the 1st serum that I have tried that is effective I'm reducing break outs. I have oily skin and and breakout often. This has helped to minimize my breakouts and control the oil. It also works as a spot treatment. Highly recommend for those with the same problems I experience.
